description: Paid ($0.25 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, or in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger): not a reading but a purchase. x402 Doctor buys the endpoint once (at most $0.1, USDC on Base, from its own wallet) with the example input its listing declares, checks the answer against the declared output schema and measures the charge on chain. Answers with a job id at once; follow it with x402_delivery_status (free), the result usually comes within minutes. The endpoint must get a "go" from the pre-payment check and be payable in USDC on Base; otherwise it is refused before payment. Same as GET /api/v1/delivery-check. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.
